scope: Read-only, signed-out desktop collection inspection plus official dated articles. Not a survey of all trends.

references.name: Cosmos — the best newspaper type

detail.back: collection URL and tile rectangle restored

references.adoption: Still image geometry; quiet contextual action; 2px image corner is a MOEMOA proposal, not an exact clone. Do not copy the full dark scrim.
references.limits: One public desktop collection; no signed-in or mobile behavior tested.

references.name: Are.na — Wild Animals vs. Manmade Materials

detail.back: scrollY440 and image rectangle restored; focus BODY, not a passed focus restoration

references.adoption: Keep content stable on hover and assign film movement to deliberate drag/click.
references.limits: One public desktop block; reorder/drag and touch not tested.

references.name: Linear — A calmer interface for a product in motion
references.method: Official article, not a logged-in app test
references.observation: Reduce secondary navigation weight and unnecessary separators; lower saturation. Some corners were made rounder, so square equals modern is not a supported generalization.
references.adoption: Remove nested shelf panels and repeated shadows; role-based 0/2/4/8px corner proposal.

references.name: Framer — Unified navigation
references.observation: Hover menus remain; carousel keyboard behavior and focus outlines are explicitly refined.
references.adoption: Do not remove alternative keyboard/button access when adding direct manipulation.

references.name: Motion — gesture and accessibility docs
references.method: Current official docs, not a dated trend announcement
references.adoption: Fine-pointer-only decorative hover; distinguish press/drag/cancel; bounded horizontal drag; no animated settling when reduced motion is requested. No Motion dependency added.

excluded.name: Savee
excluded.reason: Public Start browsing led to login and a Cloudflare check. Internal feed was not inspected.

sourceMedia: No originals downloaded or reused; reference screenshots are audit evidence only.

rootChecks.name: V5 shelf hover
rootChecks.note: Measured before final 4px preview-bar height adjustment; relative hover behavior remains identical.
